The paper’s stated 1962–2005 data period does not clarify whether it includes this forward window.

requirements.description: The 43 annual Table 3 cross-sectional samples, including stated missingness, negative assets/book equity, share-price, and annual tail screens.

variable_coverage.construction: From annual Compustat net income before extraordinary items (legacy data18) divided by lagged market value of equity. Appendix A explicitly gives the denominator as lagged data25×data199, so that definition is followed; Table 3 caption says “lagged price,” which is flagged as a source wording conflict. COMP.FUNDA has candidate ib/prcc_f/csho fields, but their historical item mapping and exact denominator units/date are not confirmed.

D = 1 when the annual CRSP return R is negative and 0 otherwise, including R=0. The annual R is compounded from monthly returns beginning in month four after actual fiscal-year end; its local return history and GVKEY-PERMNO mapping are unverified.

Annual CRSP return compounded from monthly RET observations beginning in the fourth month after the firm’s actual fiscal-year end. Match the return window to Compustat datadate through the date-effective GVKEY-PERMNO link.

design_coverage.reason: The source reports 115,516 firm-years from 1963–2005 over 43 annual fits (aggregate N, not per-fit N). It removes missing model inputs, negative assets/book equity, price below $1, and each year’s top/bottom 1% of earnings, returns, size, M/B, leverage, and depreciation. The actual `datadate` is the return-window anchor; `fyear` is only the fiscal-year label.
The source uses the CRSP–Compustat intersection. The local candidate link table has GVKEY, PERMNO and effective-date fields; code/primary-link selection and population coverage are unverified.
Equation 4 reports firm-characteristic main effects and annual cross-sectional fits, not fixed-effect dummy families. Annual grouping is not treated as year fixed effects.
No cross-sectional cluster groups are reported. Fama–MacBeth t-statistics use the standard error across the 43 annual coefficient estimates.
No regression weights are reported for the annual cross-sectional fits.

Estimate Equation 4 in annual cross-sections and report mean coefficients over 43 years; t-statistics use the standard error of those coefficients. The paper does not name the within-year cross-sectional estimator, so it remains unknown.

Drop firm-years with missing model data, negative assets or book equity, and price below $1; delete top/bottom annual 1% of earnings, returns, size, M/B, leverage, and depreciation. The source says delete, not winsorize. No filter ordering or tie rule is specified.

implementation_issues.description: Table 3 caption says earnings is scaled by lagged price, while Table 1 and Appendix A specify net income before extraordinary items divided by lagged market value of equity, with Appendix A identifying data25×data199. The assessment uses Appendix A’s explicit formula and flags the Table 3 wording; the paper does not explain whether “price” is shorthand for a per-share equivalent.

Equation (2) visually repeats μ1 for the size/M/B/leverage terms, but Equation (4) and Table 3 specify distinct return-characteristic terms, consistent with μ1–μ4. Use the complete Equation (4) RHS and flag the Equation (2) display typo.

The paper cites historical Compustat item numbers, while the local annual file exposes named fields. Do not equate items 25, 199, 60, 9, 34, or 18 to fields by number/name resemblance; an authoritative historical item crosswalk and units/date definitions are needed for exact field mapping.

The paper states 1962–2005 data and 1963–2005 firm-year fits, but annual CRSP returns begin in month four after actual fiscal year end and compound twelve monthly returns. Fiscal-year labels 2005 can therefore require monthly CRSP observations in 2006–2007; actual datadate-to-return dates must be checked rather than treating fyear labels as calendar return years.

The annual Fama–MacBeth aggregation is reported, but the within-year cross-sectional estimator is not named. Preserve it as unknown rather than infer OLS; choosing an estimator is an implementation issue for exact coefficient replication.

review_notes: The fixed Equation 4 baseline is the annual cross-sectional regression whose mean coefficients are reported in Table 3; C_Score/G_Score definitions in Equations 2–3 are not additional regression fits.
Local exact probes establish access and column presence only; no coverage confirmations were supplied. No historical Compustat item numbers were mapped by resemblance.
The source period uses fiscal-year labels. Temporal windows are anchored to actual Compustat datadate and extend the CRSP monthly return series beyond the label year as stated.
